name: Banjhakri Falls & Energy Park
description: Theme park with waterfalls, caves, and bamboo bridges. Named after traditional Lepcha shamans.

name: Do Drul Chorten
description: Giant stupa built in 1945 with 108 prayer wheels around it. One of the most important stupas in Sikkim.

name: Enchey Monastery
description: 200-year-old monastery on a hilltop with views of Kanchenjunga. Hosts the Chaam dance festival.

name: Hanuman Tok
description: Hilltop Hanuman temple maintained by the Indian Army. Closest viewpoint for Kanchenjunga from Gangtok.

name: MG Marg
description: Pedestrian-only shopping street with local eateries, boutiques, and mountain views. Heart of Gangtok.

name: Namgyal Institute of Tibetology
description: Rich collection of Tibetan Buddhist manuscripts, statues, thangkas, and tapestries. Research library.

name: Nathula Pass
description: Indo-China border pass at 14,140 ft. Open to Indian tourists on Wed-Sun with permit. Historic Silk Route trade post.

name: Rumtek Monastery
description: Seat of the Karmapa, largest monastery in Sikkim. Stunning Tibetan architecture with golden stupa inside.

name: Tashi Viewpoint
description: Panoramic viewpoint for Kanchenjunga sunrise. On clear days, the entire eastern Himalayan range is visible.

name: Chandi Devi Temple
description: Ancient hilltop Shakti temple built by King Suchat. Cable car ride with panoramic Haridwar views.

name: Ganga Aarti Ceremony
description: Spectacular fire ceremony at sunset at Har Ki Pauri with chanting, bells, and thousands of oil lamps.

name: Har Ki Pauri
description: Most sacred ghat in Haridwar where the Ganges leaves the mountains. Daily evening Ganga Aarti with thousands of floating lamps.

name: Mansa Devi Temple
description: Hilltop temple reached by cable car. Wish-fulfilling temple where devotees tie threads for blessings.

name: Patanjali Yogpeeth
description: Largest yoga institute in the world run by Baba Ramdev. Ayurvedic hospital and meditation halls.

name: Shantikunj Ashram
description: Headquarters of All World Gayatri Pariwar. Massive spiritual complex with meditation halls and yagna shala.

name: Dassam Falls
description: 44-meter waterfall meaning "ten streams". Kanchi River drops dramatically into a gorge.

name: Hundru Falls
description: 98-meter waterfall on the Subarnarekha River. 34th highest in India. Steps lead to the base pool.

name: Jonha Falls (Gautamdhara)
description: 43-meter waterfall with a Buddhist meditation center at the top. 722 steps down to the base.

name: Rock Garden Ranchi
description: Garden built from industrial waste and rocks along the Kanke Dam. Similar to Chandigarh's Rock Garden.

name: Tagore Hill
description: Hill where Rabindranath Tagore's brother lived. Panoramic views of Ranchi city. Small museum.

name: Badrinath Temple
description: Sacred Char Dham temple at 10,279 ft dedicated to Lord Vishnu. Colorful facade against Neelkanth peak backdrop.

name: Mana Village
description: Last Indian village before the Tibet border. Vyas Gufa (cave where Vedas were written) and Bhim Pul.

name: Tapt Kund
description: Natural hot water spring near the temple. Pilgrims bathe here before temple darshan. Water at 45°C.

name: Diu Fort
description: Massive Portuguese fortress on the southern tip. Cannons, lighthouse, and Arabian Sea views from the ramparts.

name: Nagoa Beach
description: Horseshoe-shaped beach with calm, shallow waters perfect for swimming. Hoka trees line the shore.

name: St. Paul's Church
description: One of the finest baroque churches in India. Ornate woodwork, shell windows, and Jesuit architecture.

name: Bhulla Lake
description: Man-made lake created by the Army. Paddle boating surrounded by dense oak and pine forests.

name: Garhwal Rifles Regimental Museum
description: Museum showcasing the valor of Garhwal Rifles regiment with weapons, uniforms, and gallantry awards.

name: Tip-N-Top (Tiffin Top)
description: Highest point in Lansdowne with views of Shivalik ranges and snow-capped peaks on clear days.

name: Rang Ghar
description: Asia's oldest surviving amphitheatre built by the Ahom dynasty for watching buffalo fights and other sports.

name: Sivasagar Tank (Borpukhuri)
description: Massive Ahom-era tank with Sivadol (tallest Shiva temple in India), Vishnudol, and Devidol on its banks.

name: Talatal Ghar
description: Ahom palace with 3 underground floors and 2 secret tunnel escape routes. Largest Ahom monument.

name: Bhaderwah Meadow
description: Called "Mini Kashmir". Lush valley at 5,300 ft with Jai Valley views and the Neelkanth river.

name: Chinta Valley
description: Pristine meadow 12 km from Bhaderwah with thick forest cover and snow-capped peaks.

name: Hanle Monastery
description: Remote 17th-century Drukpa Kagyu monastery on a hillock overlooking the Hanle plains and observatory.

name: Indian Astronomical Observatory
description: One of the world's highest optical observatories at 14,764 ft. Night sky among the clearest on Earth.

name: Lamayuru Monastery
description: Oldest monastery in Ladakh dating to the 10th century. Famous for annual mask dance festival. Lunar landscape.

name: Moonland
description: Surreal lunar landscape of eroded clay formations. Once an ancient lakebed, now resembling the moon surface.

name: Osian Sand Dunes
description: Desert dunes near the temples. Camel safari and desert camping with clear night skies.

name: Osian Temple Complex
description: Group of Jain and Hindu temples from 8th-12th century. Called "Khajuraho of Rajasthan" for erotic carvings.

name: Laxman Temple
description: Exquisitely carved 7th-century brick temple. One of the finest examples of early Indian temple architecture.

name: Sirpur Archaeological Site
description: Ruins of the 5th-8th century Buddhist-Hindu-Jain complex. Laxman Temple — one of the oldest brick temples in India.

name: Pakhui Tiger Reserve
description: Important tiger corridor connecting Nameri NP in Assam. Elephant safari and river rafting on Jia-Bharali.

name: Dudhwa Tiger Safari
description: Terai ecosystem park with Bengal tigers, one-horned rhinos (reintroduced), and swamp deer. Elephant safari available.

name: Moreh Border Market
description: India-Myanmar border town with a bustling cross-border market. Burmese goods, fabrics, and electronics.

name: Sinthan Top Pass
description: Mountain pass at 12,297 ft connecting Kashmir to Kishtwar. Snow-covered meadows and panoramic views.
